natural_query: Give me who have pending task?
sql:
SELECT u._id, u.name 
FROM "users" u 
LEFT JOIN "createtasks" t ON t."createdBy" = u._id 
WHERE t.status = 'Pending' AND NOT t.deleted 
GROUP BY u._id, u.name

SELECT t."Task", t.status 
FROM "createtasks" t 
LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = t."createdBy" 
WHERE u.name = 'kartik' AND NOT t.deleted

natural_query: Share me yesh bhide pending task list
sql:
SELECT t."Task", t.status, t.priority, t.due_date, u.name AS created_by 
FROM "createtasks" t 
LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = t."createdBy" 
WHERE t.status = 'Pending' AND u.name = 'Yesh Bhide' AND NOT t.deleted ORDER BY t.due_date ASC

SELECT 
  d._id, 
  d.name, 
  d.stage, 
  d.grand_total_in_usd, 
  c."categoryName"
FROM "deals" d 
LEFT JOIN "categories" c ON c._id = d.type 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
ORDER BY d.grand_total_in_usd DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT 
  d.stage, 
  COUNT(d._id) AS deal_count 
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  d.stage 
ORDER BY 
  deal_count DESC

natural_query: Give me all deals with year wise stages status count
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz) AS deal_year,
  d.stage,
  COUNT(d._id) AS deal_count
FROM 
  "deals" d
WHERE 
  NOT d.deleted
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."closeDate",'')::timestamptz),
  d.stage
ORDER BY 
  deal_year,
  deal_count DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.grandtotal_in_usd), 0) AS revenue 
FROM "invoices" i 
WHERE i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) = 2027 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(i.payment_date,'')::timestamptz) = 9

natural_query: List new leads from this week
sql:
SELECT 
  d._id, 
  d.name, 
  d.stage, 
  d.grand_total_in_usd, 
  c."companyName", 
  u.name AS owner_name
FROM 
  "deals" d
  LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = d.company 
  LEFT JOIN "users" u ON u._id = d.owner
WHERE 
  d.stage = 'Analysis - To be Quoted' 
  AND d.type = 'New Business' 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  AND EXTRACT(WEEK FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT 
  COUNT(d._id) AS new_leads 
FROM 
  "deals" d 
WHERE 
  d.stage = 'Analysis - To be Quoted' 
  AND d.type = 'New Business' 
  AND NOT d.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(d."createdAt",'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT 
  c._id,
  c."firstName",
  c."lastName",
  c.email,
  c."jobTitle",
  c."phoneNumber",
  c."lifecycleStage",
  c."leadStatus"
FROM "contacts" c 
WHERE NOT deleted 
  AND c."lifecycleStage" = 'Lead' 
  AND c."leadStatus" = 'New'
ORDER BY c._id DESC 
LIMIT 5

natural_query: Show me the total sales for last month
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.grand_total_in_usd), 0) AS total_sales 
FROM "sales" s 
WHERE s.status = 'Confirm' AND NOT s.deleted 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 
  OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) = 1 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = 12 
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NULLIF(s.sales_date,'')::timestamptz) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1)

SELECT 
  i.invoice_number, 
  i.grandtotal_in_usd, 
  c."companyName", 
  i.invoice_date, 
  i.due_date 
FROM "invoices" i 
LEFT JOIN "companies" c ON c._id = i.company 
WHERE i.payment_status IN ('draft', 'pending', 'partial_payment') 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
ORDER BY i.invoice_date DESC

SELECT 
  i.invoice_number, 
  i.grandtotal_in_usd, 
  i.due_date, 
  i.payment_status
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  NOT i.deleted 
  AND NULLIF(i.due_date,'')::timestamptz < NOW() 
  AND i.payment_status NOT IN ('paid','cancelled')

SELECT UPPER(COALESCE(d.currency,'USD')) AS currency, COALESCE(SUM(d.grand_total),0) AS total_collection 
FROM "deals" d 
WHERE NOT d.deleted 
GROUP BY 1 
ORDER BY 2 DESC

natural_query: Get revenue summary for last 6 months
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency, 'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total), 0) AS amount
FROM 
  "invoices" i
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
  AND NULLIF(i.payment_date, '')::timestamptz >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 month'
GROUP BY 
  1 
ORDER BY 
  2 DESC

natural_query: Show me top 10 invoices by that amount
sql:
SELECT 
  UPPER(COALESCE(i.currency,'USD')) AS currency, 
  COALESCE(SUM(i.grand_total),0) AS amount
FROM 
  "invoices" i 
WHERE 
  i.payment_status = 'paid' 
  AND NOT i.deleted 
GROUP BY 
  1 
ORDER BY 
  2 DESC 
LIMIT 10
